# 110. Semis, fisksoppa och den amerikanska optimismen

**Feed**: borssurr  
**Published**: 2026-07-03  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

Hosts Gabriel Mälkvist and Henrik Mitteman recap an extremely strong Q2 for US tech and semiconductors (Nasdaq 100's second-best quarter since the dot-com era, SOX up 88%), framing resilience to bad news as a bullish signal and contrasting American stock-market optimism with European/French pessimism. They cover a wave of Nordic M&A and corporate 'de-conglomeration' (Castellum property sales, Humana/Ambea, Fortum/Elmera, Munters, SKF, Stora Enso, SCT, Billerud) and reaffirm Investor as a core long-term holding whose premium is justified, while flagging skepticism toward crowded analyst consensus (Verisure) and a controversial Sivers share issue.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 INVE-B — Investor | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 90%

Hosts' core long-term holding; premium justified by 15-year index-beating record and proven ability to fix troubled holdings.

#### Reasoning

Host explicit conviction restated at open and close of episode: buy Investor as the portfolio base, sleep well, works even for young investors starting out. Premium to NAV framed as fair given track record versus a plain index fund that trades flat to NAV.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the historical premium collapses or reverses to a discount
- if portfolio turnaround bets fail to deliver
- if the multi-decade index-beating streak breaks

> *"Men Investor ska vara basen... Köp Investor för allt du kan. Så gott om natten."*

---

### 🟠 VERS — Verisure | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

All 12 covering analyst houses rate it 'buy' yet the stock is down ~12% in a month; host explicitly skeptical of such crowded consensus.

#### Reasoning

Host argues newly-listed companies get inflated buy ratings because the IPO banks themselves cover the stock, and notes that despite unanimous buy calls the share has fallen sharply recently, making him distrust the consensus rather than follow it.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the stock keeps declining despite unanimous buy ratings, confirming analyst bias
- if IPO-bank-linked coverage is shown to be unreliable

> *"Jag tycker att det är så intressant med de här. När det är en sån här otrolig konsensus, då blir man ju alltid skeptisk."*

---

### 🟢 MTRS — Munters | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Fastest-growing name in the ventilation group over 5 years; divesting FoodTech to become a pure-play data-center winner.

#### Reasoning

Host highlights Munters as interesting now that it is shedding its less attractive FoodTech unit to focus purely on data-center-driven air treatment, framing the renodling (de-conglomeration) as a positive catalyst, though he notes no obvious buyer exists for the divested unit.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the FoodTech divestment stalls for lack of a buyer
- if data-center-related demand slows

> *"Men jag tycker Munters är intressant nu när man ska sälja fotech och göra... Renodlad datacentervinnare."*

---

### 🟢 SAND — Sandvik | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Cited by columnist Anders Egersten as a completed turnaround alongside ABB and Volvo.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited analyst/columnist view (Anders Egersten) rather than the hosts' own strong conviction; Sandvik is grouped with ABB and Volvo as having 'turned', implying improving fundamentals worth watching.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the cited turnaround fails to show up in results
- if industrial/mining demand weakens

> *"Sandvik har vänts, ABB har vänts, till och med Volvo har vänts."*

---

### 🟠 ABB — ABB | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Also called 'turned' but now so hot that hosts question whether it's still worth owning at current valuation.

#### Reasoning

Unlike Sandvik and Volvo, ABB draws an explicit valuation caveat from the hosts, who wonder if the stock has become too expensive to buy despite its improved fundamentals, making this a watch rather than an outright buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the valuation multiple compresses from current highs
- if growth fails to justify the premium

> *"ABB är så hett nu att man undrar om det fortfarande är liksom är värt att våga äga."*

---

### 🟢 VOLV-B — Volvo | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Cited turnaround completed, with chairman Jan Gurander credited as central to the shift.

#### Reasoning

Grouped with Sandvik and ABB as a cited example of a successful corporate turnaround; chairman Jan Gurander's role is highlighted as a template now hoped to be repeated at SCT.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the turnaround narrative reverses
- if truck-cycle demand weakens

> *"Han skriver att Jan Gurander, ordförande, var central också när Volvo vände."*

---

### 🟠 BILL — Billerud | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 35%

Long-troubled forestry-industry stock; new chairman Magnus Nicolin (also chairs Munters) floated as a possible turnaround trigger.

#### Reasoning

Cited by columnist Anders Egersten as a possible next renodling/turnaround case given years of problems and a newly elected chairman with a track record at Munters; purely speculative at this stage.

#### Sell Triggers

- if pulp/paper prices stay weak
- if the new chairman fails to change strategy

> *"Han nämner Billerud apropå skogsindustrin som har dragits med problem i åratal. Men Magnus Nicolén har valt sig ordförande."*

---

### 🟠 SINCH — Sinch | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Triton's takeover bid for Sinch has been raised after the firm was fined SEK 100m over the original bid.

#### Reasoning

The raised bid is a positive near-term M&A catalyst, though hosts express confusion over why Triton was fined so heavily, adding uncertainty to the deal's path.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Triton's raised bid is withdrawn or rejected
- if the regulatory fine issue escalates further

> *"Triton fick hundra miljoner i böter för budet på Sint som nu har höjts."*

---

### ⛔ SIVE — Sivers | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Directed share issue at a 10% discount sent the stock down 15%; shorts flag inconsistent Swedish/English disclosure on use of proceeds.

#### Reasoning

Hosts relay bull and bear cases: US institutions participated in the raise, but critics note the company has little cash, question whether the SEK 600m raised is for expansion or just operations, and flag differing disclosure between Swedish and English press releases.

#### Sell Triggers

- if use of the raised capital remains unclear or is spent on operations rather than growth
- if disclosure discrepancies are confirmed as misleading

> *"Vad fan får jag för pengarna? Är det bara rörelsefinansiering eller är det verkligen en expansion..."*

---

### 🟠 AXFO — Axfood | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Historically richly valued despite limited growth; growth now slowing further under a new, unproven CEO.

#### Reasoning

Hosts question whether Axfood's long-standing premium valuation is still deserved as growth slows, and float (semi-jokingly) that capital could rotate out of defensive names like Axfood into cyclicals/semis if the economy turns; want to hear directly from the new CEO.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth slows further without recovery
- if the market rotates decisively out of defensive staples into cyclicals
- if the new CEO fails to reverse the slowdown

> *"Det har ju alltid varit ganska högt värderat, får man ju säga, trots ganska begränsad tillväxt."*

---

### 🟠 NKE — Nike | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Five years of weak performance; latest report not strong but decent enough to suggest a possible bottom.

#### Reasoning

Host frames Nike's report as a potential 'bottom is in' signal under CEO Elliot Hill, while acknowledging Converse, China sales and tariffs remain clear drags and management itself admits results aren't where they need to be yet.

#### Sell Triggers

- if China sales keep declining
- if Converse keeps underperforming
- if tariffs keep pressuring margins

> *"En inte stark rapport i veckan, men en liksom hygglig rapport som skulle kunna vara en botten-känning."*

---

### 🟠 DUST — Dustin | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Possible turnaround name; a viewer noted a decent recent earnings report.

#### Reasoning

Mentioned briefly alongside Klarna as a formerly unloved stock that may be turning, based on a viewer-flagged decent report rather than the hosts' own deep analysis.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the improved report doesn't repeat in subsequent quarters

> *"En tittare påpekade att även Dustin kom in med en hygglig rapport i dagarna apropå dåliga bolag som ska vända."*

---

### 🟠 KLAR — Klarna | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Formerly unloved fintech now performing well on Wall Street, cited as part of a broader turnaround-candidate theme.

#### Reasoning

Grouped with Dustin as a name people have started liking again; hosts note it is doing well on Wall Street post-IPO but don't go deep into fundamentals.

#### Sell Triggers

- if Wall Street sentiment toward the stock reverses
- if growth or profitability disappoints

> *"Och till och med Klarna går bra på Wall Street."*

---

### 🟢 CAST — Castellum | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Sold Stockholm properties to Alecta at a 12% premium to book value, the second big disposal in two weeks, validating its stated valuations.

#### Reasoning

Host calls the deal genius because Castellum is proving it can defend the valuations it carries on its books by actually executing sales at a premium, following last week's Vilborg transaction which was at a discount by comparison.

#### Sell Triggers

- if future disposals fail to achieve premium pricing
- if the broader pattern of property companies swapping assets is seen as circular/collusive rather than genuine price discovery

> *"Alltså det är genialt av Castellum, tycker jag... Nu sålde man Stockholms fastigheter med 12% premium mot bokfört värde."*

---

### 🟢 MAERSK-B — Maersk | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Raised full-year 2026 EBITDA guidance, framed as a beneficiary of the Hormuz Strait crisis via freight/oil dynamics.

#### Reasoning

Host cites the guidance raise as evidence Maersk is winning from current geopolitical/oil-market conditions, part of a broader 'everyone wins from the Hormuz crisis' dynamic (low oil, high stocks) that should support earnings.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the Hormuz-crisis freight/oil tailwind fades
- if global trade volumes weaken, pressuring shipping rates

> *"Mersk också som höjde sin helårsprognos faktiskt för 2026. Vinnaren på Hörmutskris."*

---

### 🟢 ELUX-B — Electrolux | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Large, painful rights issue, but the owner took responsibility and stayed committed long-term, which hosts say deserves a valuation premium.

#### Reasoning

Host draws a parallel to the Investor discussion, arguing that an owner willing to fund a big, dilutive rights issue and stick with a company long-term is a positive signal worth paying up for.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the rights issue fails to fix the balance sheet
- if the long-term owner's commitment weakens or exits

> *"Intressant med en stor och smärtsam nyemission där man ändå tar ägaransvar och är långsiktig. Jag tycker också att det är värt ett premie."*

---

### ⛔ LATO-B — Latour | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 55%

Historically flagged as trading at an 80-90% premium to NAV, called 'crazy' expensive by the hosts.

#### Reasoning

Used as a contrast case to Investor's more modest premium; hosts recall having previously criticized Latour's valuation as excessive, implying caution on the name at current multiples.

#### Sell Triggers

- would reconsider only if the premium normalizes materially toward peer investment-company levels

> *"Vi har ju pratat om Latour tidigare som handlas med enorma premier. Alldeles för mycket, det var ju helt galet."*

---
